title: FriendsNotes
description: Player management, built-in messenger and tracking of teammates' HP. Add notes, highlight friends and enemies, monitor the health of your allies in real time!
body:
PlayerNotes - Player Management & Team Coordination

**PlayerNotes** is a comprehensive client-side mod for Minecraft Fabric that helps you track players, communicate with them, and monitor your teammates' health in real-time.

Key Features

Player Management System
- Add players to your list with custom notes
- Mark players as friends (green highlight) or enemies (red highlight)
- Save important information about each player
- Edit and delete entries anytime
- Reorder players with up/down arrows

Built-in Messenger
- Send private messages directly from the mod interface
- Message history saved for each player
- Convenient interface with auto-scroll to latest messages
- Opens by clicking on a player card

Player Highlighting
- Toggle-able highlighting of friends and enemies through walls
- Green glow for friends, red for enemies
- Automatically hides when players crouch (Shift)
- Hotkey for quick toggle

Favorites System
- Add important players to favorites with a beautiful golden star
- Real-time HP display for favorite players on HUD
- Compact HUD showing player head and health hearts
- Customizable HUD position (4 screen corners)

List Management
- Change player order with up/down arrows
- Beautiful cards with gradients and animations
- Online status indicator
- Player skin display

Commands

- `/pnhud topleft` or `/pnhud tl` - HUD in top left corner
- `/pnhud topright` or `/pnhud tr` - HUD in top right corner (default)
- `/pnhud bottomleft` or `/pnhud bl` - HUD in bottom left corner
- `/pnhud bottomright` or `/pnhud br` - HUD in bottom right corner

Keybindings

Configurable in Minecraft controls settings:
- **Open PlayerNotes Menu** - opens the main mod menu
- **Toggle Highlight** - enables/disables player highlighting

Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/)
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Download PlayerNotes and place in `mods` folder
4. Launch the game!

Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 1.21.1
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.16.5+
- **Fabric API**: 0.105.0+ (required)

How to Use

1. Open the mod menu (configure hotkey)
2. Click "Add Player" and enter username
3. Select status (friend/enemy/neutral) and add a note
4. Click the star to the left of the player's head to add to favorites
5. Use arrows to change order (appear on hover)
6. Click on a player card to open messenger

Interface Features

- Modern design with gradients and shadows
- Smooth animations and hover effects
- Adaptive interface
- Color-coded player status
- Compact HUD that doesn't clutter the screen

Report a Bug

About the Developer

I'm a beginner programmer learning to create Minecraft mods. This is one of my first projects, and I'm constantly learning and improving. If you have any suggestions, want to report a bug, or just want to chat about the mod, feel free to reach out!

**Contact me on Telegram: @viollnon**

I appreciate any feedback, bug reports, or feature suggestions. Your input helps me grow as a developer and makes this mod better for everyone!
